Raw NR7 exports for Sri Lanka from the CBD Online Reporting Tool (public API), fetched 2026-10-30 by scripts/fetch_nr7_ort.py. All feed nr7_lka.json: section3.csv (national targets), headline.csv (indicator series), binary.csv (GBF questionnaire, with the tool's own question wording) and, where the report files rows under the GBF targets themselves, national_targets.csv and section3_keys.json (what each row is filed under, from the report's own record).
